cameraForm.mustBeBelowTheClear: Must be below the CLEAR threshold
cameraForm.oneCameraWatchesOneEmergency: One camera watches one emergency exit.
cameraForm.name: Name
cameraForm.mustBeUniqueTheBackend: Must be unique — the backend rejects duplicates.
cameraForm.rtspUserPassHost554: rtsp://user:pass@host:554/stream1 — or a path to a local video file to exercise the pipeline without a camera.
cameraForm.detectsObstaclesAndMeasuresWhat: Detects obstacles and measures what overlaps the exit region you draw. Works with the stock COCO weights.
cameraForm.comparesTheVisibleDoorAgainst: Compares the visible door against a stored unobstructed reference. Needs door weights (DOOR_MODEL_PATH) and a reference capture.
cameraForm.enabledCamerasStartTheirWorker: Enabled cameras start their worker as soon as they are saved, and again whenever the backend restarts.
cameraForm.leaveAFieldEmptyTo: Leave a field empty to inherit the global value from the backend's .env.
cameraForm.atOrAboveThisAccessible: At or above this accessible %, the exit is CLEAR.
cameraForm.belowThisAccessibleTheExit: Below this accessible %, the exit counts as FULL.
cameraForm.howLongAnObstructionMust: How long an obstruction must persist before it is believed — this is what ignores passers-by.
cameraForm.howLongItMustStay: How long it must stay clear before the event closes.
cameraForm.framesAnalysedPerSecondNot: Frames analysed per second — not the stream's own frame rate. Higher costs CPU per camera.
cameraForm.doorCentricNeedsDoorOnly: Door-centric needs door-only weights configured on the backend (DOOR_MODEL_PATH) and a reference frame captured while the exit is clear. Without them the registry falls back to the default strategy rather than failing.
